name: Oriental Aromatics Ltd
title: Oriental Aromatics Ltd-$ - 500078 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 6.6% from 10.06% on a triple input-cost shock, Chinese oversupply and Mahad drag; management guides only to a return to ~10% and gives no FY27 revenue number.

utilisation.quote: most of the plants are running between 80% to 90% to ensure that we cover all our overheads

capex.peers_comment: Management said Indian camphor overcapacity needs rationalising, but gave no capex or deferral figures.
capex.quote: unless the re is a massiv e reorganizing of the Indian camphor capacity happening in the coming quarters

triggers.label: Indian camphor overcapacity acknowledged
triggers.quote: the bigger challenge is the overcapacity in India, which nee ds to get rationalized
triggers.highlight: overcapacity in India, which nee ds to get rationalized

triggers.label: Receivables and SME payables up sharply
triggers.quote: our trade receivables have gone up by almost 40% odd
triggers.highlight: trade receivables have gone up by almost 40% odd

triggers.label: Mahad 75–80% utilisation targeted in a year
triggers.quote: we should be in a position to not only make it EBITDA neutral but start contributing

guidance.quote: it will be our endeavor to go back to the guided number of around 10%

guidance.metric: Mahad incremental revenue at current capacity
guidance.value: INR 50 crore; INR 60-65 crore at optimum utilisation
guidance.quote: At the current capacity, it will be around INR 50 crores additional revenue.
we should be in a position to achieve utilization of the plant which is anywhere between 75% to 80%
that should very easily be anywhere between INR 1200 crores to INR 1250 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: continues to be a drag on our consolidated EBITDA margins to the extent of between 1% to 1.5% as we have guided in the past few quarters

red_flags.label: Receivables up ~40% vs revenue ~11%
red_flags.quote: while our top line has gone up by, say, 11 % odd, but our trade receivables have gone up by almost 40% odd

red_flags.label: Stockpiling of petro raw materials
red_flags.quote: We have taken conscious steps in the last one and a half, two months to kind of overstock those materials across all the three verticals.

red_flags.label: Extended customer credit absorbed in price
red_flags.quote: we have been told by some of our top customers globally to give extended credit period, which we are offering to them

evasions.quote: So, I would not be in a position to give you an absolute number
So, I would not be able to comment on what my industry peers do.
We have had conversations at various levels, which I will not be in a position to elaborate on this forum.
